results.question: How do I install SCHNAIL?
results.text: Register an account at www.schnail.com; Login on the website; Download the latest release of SCHNAIL from www.schnail.com/#/downloads; Download and install Java JRE (Recommended: Liberica Java JDK 21 LTS); Install SCHNAIL (Note: Your antivirus may flag the SCHNAIL client - make sure to allow it to run); Launch the SCHNAIL client and log in with your credentials; The client will automatically download and set up the game files; Start playing against the AI

results.question: How do I use the Remastered SCM map?
results.text: Ensure StarCraft Remastered is installed and updated.; Download the BWAPI integrated SCM map archive from Proton Drive or Direct Download.; Extract the downloaded ZIP file to your StarCraft maps folder (typically Documents\StarCraft\Maps).; Launch StarCraft Remastered.; Navigate to Single Player → Custom Game.; Select the extracted BWAPI map.; Crucial Step: Under Game Type, you MUST select "Use Map Settings". The AI will not function properly in a standard Melee game.; Start the game and enjoy playing against the advanced AI!
